note: 생활 장면표(계획 Task 4, 2026-11-19) — 그 도시 사람들이 실제로 보내는 하루의 장면을 세 세계로 옮긴다(설계 3-1절). 장면은 그 도시에 실제로 있는 생활 모습만, 근거 src(위키백과). 장면 한 줄: key · ko · src · base(받침 · 장소 종류 · 자세 추천을 빌리는 일상컷 트리 장소 — data/casual-tree*.json) · indoor(날씨 줄 없음) · times · seasons(되는 시간대 · 계절 — 없으면 다) · outfits(이 장면에서 계획기가 고르는 의상 계열) · en(세계를 타지 않은 장면 이름 — 트리 장소 글, 지시문에는 안 나온다) · worlds.<세계>.en(같은 일상이 그 세계의 시대로 옮겨진 모습 — 일상컷 Place 줄) · props(소품 열쇠 — data/world-props.json, Around her 줄). 조립기(lib/prompt-city.js lifeTree)가 장면마다 트리 장소 <도시>_<장면> 을 만든다(받침은 base 것, 땅 = 도시). times 는 모든 도시가 같이, seasons · weather 는 도시마다(그 도시에 맞는 것만, 근거). 판타지 · 스팀펑크 글에는 그 세계 banned_en(data/city-design.json) 낱말이 없다(tests/prompt-city.cjs).

times.en: dawn — the first pale light before the city wakes, the last lamps still lit and the streets quiet
the morning rush hour — low clean sunlight and the city's crowd hurrying to work
the evening rush after work — the warm low sun sinking into dusk and lamps coming on along the street
evening turning to night — the scene lit by its own lamps and windows under a dark sky
past midnight — the last lamps still burning and the streets nearly empty

seoul.en: spring — cherry blossoms in bloom and petals drifting on the air
the jangma rainy season of early summer — heavy, humid air under low grey skies
high summer — hot, humid air and strong sunlight
autumn — cool, clear, dry air and turning leaves
winter — cold, dry, frosty air, breath showing in the cold
a jangma downpour — warm, heavy rain and wet ground shining
a passing rain shower — wet streets shining and the air washed clean
muggy heat — the air thick and damp, a haze over the distance
a yellow-dust day — the spring sky veiled in a pale ochre haze
morning fog after a clear, cold night
light snow falling through the cold, dry air, frost on every edge

scenes.en: a riverside park lawn at night with a picnic mat and a late supper

fantasy.en: the grassy bank of the wide silver river below the royal capital at night — a woven rush mat spread on the grass, a late supper of roasted skewers and rice cakes in lacquered boxes, lantern-boats drifting on the water and the palace lights across the river

steampunk.en: the lamplit grassy embankment of the wide shining river at night — a canvas groundsheet on the grass, a late supper of fried chicken in a ribbon-tied paper parcel and stoneware bottles of beer, the brass-trimmed truss bridge glowing with gas lamps and a paddle steamer gliding past in soft white steam

cyberpunk.en: the floodlit river-park lawn at night — a glowing mat on the grass, a late fried-chicken delivery in heat-sealed boxes just dropped by a drone, stacked tiers of luminous maglev arches over the river and holographic ads reflected on the black water

scenes.en: a crowded subway at rush hour

fantasy.en: a crowded rune-lit underground carriage gliding through the tunnels beneath the royal capital at rush hour — carved wooden benches along the walls, brass hand-loops swaying overhead, travelers in cloaks reading folded broadsheets

steampunk.en: a packed steam-hauled underground railway carriage at rush hour — polished wooden benches, leather hand-straps hanging from a brass rail, gas lamps glowing in etched-glass shades as the tunnel rushes past the windows in wisps of white steam, clerks in bowler hats reading newspapers

cyberpunk.en: a packed driverless maglev car at rush hour — a sleek curved cabin of smart glass, chrome grab rails, passengers lit by the glow of their wrist screens, holographic route maps flickering over the doors

scenes.en: a tented street-food stall at night

fantasy.en: a tented night stall at the edge of the market road under magic lanterns — a canvas awning glowing from within, a charcoal brazier roasting skewers, a simmering iron pot of spicy rice cakes and low wooden stools at a plank counter

steampunk.en: a street-food handcart stall at night under a striped canvas awning — a gleaming brass steam boiler and a hot griddle of skewers, gas lamps on poles, a narrow polished-wood counter with stools and soft clouds of white steam

cyberpunk.en: a street-food tent stall at night under a translucent smart-fabric awning glowing pink and cyan — a holographic menu board floating over the counter, skewers on an induction grill, steam rising through layers of light

scenes.en: a heated public bathhouse hall with sauna rooms

fantasy.en: a heated stone bathhouse hall of the capital — warm ondol floors under woven mats, a domed kiln-sauna glowing with enchanted embers, bathers resting on wooden pillows and eggs baking among hot river stones

steampunk.en: a gaslit public bathhouse hall — a brick kiln-sauna behind a brass-bound door, steam pipes warming the stone floor, bathers lounging on mats under gas lamps and a tea counter with enamel cups

cyberpunk.en: an all-night heated spa hall — glowing ceramic sleep pods, a kiln-sauna lit amber from inside, wall screens of drifting ocean light and a vending bar of glowing drinks

scenes.en: a covered market with food stalls frying mung-bean pancakes

fantasy.en: a covered market hall of the royal capital — rows of food stalls under painted beams, mung-bean pancakes frying in a great iron pan over a fire, rolls of rice and greens on wooden boards and merchants calling out under silk banners

steampunk.en: a glass-roofed market arcade on brass-trimmed girders — food stalls in long rows, mung-bean pancakes sizzling on a hot griddle, gas lamps, enamel signs and white steam curling up into the skylights

cyberpunk.en: a crowded night-market arcade on a sky-bridge level between towers — food stalls under stacked holographic signs, mung-bean pancakes frying on a robot-arm griddle, glowing prices floating above the steaming trays

scenes.en: a cafe in an old tiled-roof house down a narrow lane

fantasy.en: a tea house in a tiled-roof house down a lane too narrow for a cart — paper lattice doors slid open to a tiny courtyard, a low lacquered table with a celadon teapot and rice cakes on a wooden tray

steampunk.en: a coffee house in an old tiled-roof house down a narrow lane — a brass siphon coffee apparatus hissing on the counter, glass-paned lattice doors, an iron stove and gaslight on dark wood

cyberpunk.en: a cafe in an old tiled-roof house down a narrow lane, gutted and rebuilt inside — glass walls under the curved roof, a robotic barista arm, glowing table tops and neon trim tracing the old beams

scenes.en: the courtyard of her own old tiled-roof house on a hillside

fantasy.en: the stone-paved inner courtyard of her own tiled-roof house on a hillside of the capital — a wooden veranda, crocks of soy and pepper paste, a persimmon tree and the curved roofs of the neighbours stepping down the hill

steampunk.en: the inner courtyard of her tiled-roof house on a hillside of the gaslamp city — a wooden veranda, earthenware crocks, laundry lines, a copper water heater ticking on the wall and wisps of white steam rising beyond the curved roofs

cyberpunk.en: the inner courtyard of her old tiled-roof house on a hillside of the megacity — a wooden veranda, earthenware crocks beside a drone landing pad, glowing mesh lanterns and arcology towers rising kilometres high behind the curved roofs

scenes.en: a stone-walled stream through the city centre with a walking path

fantasy.en: the stone-walled stream that runs through the heart of the capital — stepping stones across clear water, willow branches, paper lanterns floating downstream and people strolling along the stone path

steampunk.en: the stone-walled canal through the city centre — iron footbridges with brass lamp-posts, gas lamps along the stone path, little water-wheels and polished steam pipes along the walls and people strolling in the evening

cyberpunk.en: the stone-walled stream sunk below the megacity's towers — stepping stones lit from beneath, light-art installations shimmering over the water and people strolling with glowing ear-pieces

scenes.en: a walking trail along an old stone city wall on a ridge

fantasy.en: the trail along the great stone city wall on the ridge above the capital — battlements, pine trees, a gate pavilion ahead and the golden palace roofs far below

steampunk.en: the trail along the old stone city wall on the ridge above the gaslamp city — battlements, pine trees, a brass signal mast and below a valley of tiled roofs, glass domes and drifting white steam

cyberpunk.en: the trail along the old stone city wall on the ridge above the megacity — battlements and pine trees, a sea of arcology towers and sky-bridges below and flying vehicles drifting in lanes of light at eye level

scenes.en: the cheering stands of a ballpark at an evening game

fantasy.en: the packed stands of a great ball-game arena of the capital at an evening match — rows of fans chanting songs together, pennants waving, lantern light over the field and roasted fowl and wine shared along the benches

steampunk.en: the packed timber stands of a ballpark at an evening game — fans singing fight songs in unison, a brass band, tin rattles, gas floodlights on iron towers and fried chicken passed along the rows

cyberpunk.en: the packed stands of a domed ballpark at a night game — the crowd singing fight songs, glowing thundersticks, holographic replays over the field and fried chicken delivered to the seats by drone

scenes.en: an open-air riverside swimming pool in summer

fantasy.en: a riverside bathing pool beside the wide silver river in high summer — clear water in stone basins, striped silk awnings, bathers on the warm stone edge and the palace hills beyond

steampunk.en: a riverside open-air bathing pool in high summer — a brass-railed diving tower, striped canvas awnings, a gleaming steam pump churning fresh water into the basin and the truss railway bridge beyond

cyberpunk.en: a riverside open-air pool in high summer — water glowing turquoise from underwater lights, inflatable rings, a misting fan array over the deck and glass towers across the river

scenes.en: the roof outside her small rooftop room on a warm night

fantasy.en: the flat roof outside her little room atop a house in the capital on a warm night — a low wooden bench, potted herbs, laundry on a line and the lantern-lit city with its palace lights spread below

steampunk.en: the flat roof outside her small room atop a tenement on a warm night — a copper water tank on iron legs, laundry on a line, chimney pots all around and the warm gaslight of the city glowing across the roofs

cyberpunk.en: the roof outside her tiny rooftop room above an old tenement on a warm night — printed-polymer stools, a humming climate unit, potted plants under a grow-light and the layered towers and flying-vehicle lanes of the megacity filling the sky
